title: Rhythm Strips and 12-Leads: Recognise, Record, Help
next: Chapter 30, Lesson 5: Cardiac arrest, electrical therapy, heart pumps and heart medicines

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already take a pulse, read SpO₂, and let the AED read the rhythm for you. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Place electrodes well and read a strip in five steps
  2. Recognise the rhythms that slow, speed up or stop the heart
  3. Help get a clean 12-lead, and know what a STEMI means for nitro

Textbook: Chapter 30, PDF pages 2618–2736
slides.say: Welcome back. As an EMR, you've used an AED, a machine that reads the heart rhythm and decides whether to shock. Today we look at that electricity ourselves. One honest note: the BC exam protocols we study don't list rhythm interpretation or twelve-lead ECGs for EMRs or PCPs. So our goal is to understand them, recognise danger, and help your advanced care partner. The written exam can still ask about them. We'll cover three things: reading a strip in five steps, the rhythms that slow, speed up or stop the heart, and the twelve-lead, including what it means for nitroglycerin.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎回来。作为 EMR，你用过 AED，它会读心律、决定要不要电击。今天我们自己来看这些电信号。先说一句实话：我们学习的 BC 考试流程没有把心律判读和 12 导联心电图列给 EMR 或 PCP。所以我们的目标是：理解它、认出危险、帮上你的高级生命支持搭档。笔试也照样可能考。今天讲三件事：用五步读心电条；让心跳变慢、变快或停止的心律；以及 12 导联，包括它对硝酸甘油的意义。

slides.title: The monitor is a vital sign
slides.body:
Treat the ECG as another vital sign

  • Who: chest pain, possible heart problem, fast or slow pulse
  • Heart history, and many older patients
  • Continuous view: leads I, II, III; lead II is usually best
  • Cardiac event suspected? A 12-lead should follow
  • It shows electricity, not pumping: feel the pulse
slides.say: The book asks you to treat the ECG as another vital sign, like the blood pressure. Who needs one? Anyone with chest pain, a possible heart problem, a pulse that's too fast or too slow, a heart history, and often older patients, because age itself raises heart risk. For continuous monitoring, three electrodes give leads one, two and three, and lead two usually shows the rhythm best. If you suspect a cardiac event, a twelve-lead should follow. And remember: the ECG shows electricity, not pumping. A normal-looking rhythm with no pulse is still cardiac arrest, so always check the patient.
slides.sayZh: 书里要你把心电图当作另一项生命体征，就像血压一样。谁需要？胸痛、可能有心脏问题、脉搏太快或太慢、有心脏病史的人，很多时候还有老年人，因为年龄本身就增加心脏风险。持续监护用三个电极，得到 I、II、III 导联，通常 II 导联显示节律最清楚。怀疑心脏事件，就应接着做 12 导联。还要记住：心电图显示的是电活动，不是泵血。看起来正常的节律却没有脉搏，仍然是心脏骤停，所以永远要看病人。

slides.title: Electrodes, artifact and the paper
slides.body:
• White right upper chest, black left upper, red left lower
  • Memory aid: white on the right, smoke over fire
  • Prep: shave if hairy, rub with dry gauze, clip the wire on first
Paper at 25 mm/sTime
1 small box0.04 s
1 large box (5 small)0.20 s
5 large boxes1 second

Flat line in a talking patient = loose lead, not asystole.
slides.say: A clean tracing starts with good electrodes. White goes on the right upper chest, black on the left upper chest, red on the left lower abdomen, and green, if your cable has one, on the right lower abdomen. The memory aid: white on the right, smoke over fire. Shave a hairy spot, rub the skin with dry gauze, and clip the wire on first. A messy line from poor contact or movement is called artifact. The paper runs at twenty-five millimetres a second: one small box is zero point zero four seconds, one large box zero point two, and five large boxes one second. And a flat line in a talking patient is a loose lead, not asystole.
slides.sayZh: 干净的波形从电极贴好开始。白色贴右上胸，黑色贴左上胸，红色贴左下腹；导联线有绿色的话，贴右下腹。口诀：白在右，烟（黑）在火（红）上。毛多的地方剃一下，用干纱布擦皮肤，先扣好导线再贴。接触不良或身体活动造成的乱线叫伪差。走纸速度每秒二十五毫米：一个小格零点零四秒，一个大格零点二秒，五个大格一秒。还有，正在说话的病人屏幕上是一条直线，那是导联脱落，不是心搏停止。

slides.title: Reading a strip in five steps
slides.body:
1. Find P, QRS and T: one P before every QRS?
  2. PR interval: normal 0.12–0.20 s (3–5 small boxes)
  3. QRS width: normal under 0.12 s (3 small boxes)
  4. Regular, regularly irregular, or irregularly irregular?
  5. Rate: QRS in 6 s × 10; regular: 1500 ÷ small boxes

Sequence method (regular only): 300, 150, 100, 75, 60, 50 per large box.
slides.say: Here's a five-step routine, usually in lead two. One: find the waves. The P wave is the atria firing, and the QRS is the ventricles firing. Is there one P before every QRS? Two: the PR interval, from the start of P to the start of QRS. Normal is zero point one two to zero point two seconds, three to five small boxes. Three: the QRS. Under zero point one two seconds is narrow, meaning the normal pathway. Four: is it regular? Five: the rate. QRS complexes in six seconds times ten works for any rhythm; for a regular one, fifteen hundred divided by the small boxes between R waves is most accurate.
slides.sayZh: 这是一个五步流程，通常用 II 导联。第一步，找波形：P 波是心房放电，QRS 是心室放电。是不是每个 QRS 前都有一个 P？第二步，PR 间期，从 P 起点到 QRS 起点，正常零点一二到零点二秒，也就是三到五个小格。第三步，QRS：小于零点一二秒为窄，说明走的是正常通路。第四步，节律规则吗？第五步，心率：六秒内的 QRS 个数乘以十，任何节律都适用；规则节律用一千五百除以两个 R 波之间的小格数，最准确。

slides.q: Your patient with palpitations is sitting up and talking. The monitor suddenly shows a wavy, chaotic line that looks like VF. What do you do first?
options: Tell everyone to stand clear and analyze with the AED
Look at the patient, feel a pulse, and check the electrodes
Turn up the ECG size to see the waves better
slides.say: Let's check. Your patient with palpitations is sitting up and talking. The monitor suddenly shows a wavy, chaotic line that looks like VF, ventricular fibrillation. What do you do first? A, tell everyone to stand clear and analyze with the AED. B, start chest compressions right away. C, look at the patient, feel a pulse, and check the electrodes. D, turn up the ECG size to see the waves better. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 考考你。一位心悸的病人坐着、正在说话，监护仪突然出现一条波浪状、杂乱、像室颤的线。你第一步做什么？A 叫大家离开，用 AED 分析；B 马上开始胸外按压；C 看病人、摸脉搏、检查电极；D 把心电图波幅调大看清楚。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is C. A patient in VF has no pulse and can't talk, so a chaotic line in an alert patient is almost always artifact from movement, shivering or a loose electrode. Treat the patient and the monitor together. A and B treat the screen instead of the person; you never shock or compress someone who is awake with a pulse. D doesn't fix a contact problem. Check the patient and the leads first.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 C。室颤的病人没有脉搏、不能说话，所以清醒病人身上出现杂乱的线，几乎都是活动、寒战或电极松脱造成的伪差。病人和监护仪要一起看。A 和 B 是在治屏幕而不是治人，对清醒、有脉搏的人绝不能电击或按压。D 解决不了接触问题。先看病人、查导联。

slides.title: Where the beat starts
slides.body:
PacemakerRateWhat you see
SA node60–100Upright P before every narrow QRS
Atria: AFvariesNo P waves, irregularly irregular
Atria: flutteroften 150Sawtooth waves, usually regular
AV junction40–60Narrow QRS; P hidden or upside down
Ventricles20–40Wide QRS, no P waves

Sinus rhythm under 60 = sinus bradycardia; over 100 = sinus tachycardia.
slides.say: The heart has backup pacemakers, each with its own speed. Normally the SA node, or sinus node, leads at sixty to one hundred, with an upright P before every narrow QRS. Under sixty is sinus bradycardia; over one hundred, sinus tachycardia, often from pain, fever, low oxygen or blood loss. In atrial fibrillation the atria just quiver: no P waves, irregularly irregular, and a risk of clots and stroke, so many of these patients take blood thinners. Flutter shows sawtooth waves, often at one fifty. If higher sites fail, the AV junction takes over at forty to sixty, and the ventricles at twenty to forty, with wide QRS complexes.
slides.sayZh: 心脏有备用起搏点，各有各的速度。正常由窦房结主导，每分钟六十到一百，每个窄 QRS 前有一个直立的 P 波。低于六十是窦性心动过缓；高于一百是窦性心动过速，常因疼痛、发热、缺氧或失血。房颤时心房只是在颤动：没有 P 波、绝对不规则，还有血栓和卒中的风险，所以很多这类病人在吃抗凝药。房扑是锯齿状波，心室率常为一百五十。上面的起搏点失灵时，房室交界区以四十到六十接管，心室只有二十到四十，QRS 宽大。

slides.title: Heart blocks: a delay at the AV node
slides.body:
BlockThe clue
First degreePR over 0.20 s; every P conducts
Second degree, type IPR grows longer, then one QRS drops
Second degree, type IIPR stays the same, then a QRS suddenly drops
Third degreeP waves and QRS ignore each other

Type II, and third degree with wide QRS, are the dangerous ones: the book often needs pacing.
slides.say: The AV node normally holds each beat briefly so the ventricles can fill. When that delay grows too long, it's called an AV block, or heart block. In first degree, the PR is longer than zero point two seconds, but every beat gets through. In second degree type one, the PR grows longer and longer until one beat drops, then the cycle restarts. In type two, the PR stays the same, then a beat suddenly fails to conduct. In third degree, nothing gets through, so the P waves and QRS complexes ignore each other. Type two, and third degree with wide complexes, can crash, and the book often paces them.
slides.sayZh: 房室结正常会把每次冲动稍微延迟一下，让心室充盈。延迟太长就叫房室传导阻滞，也叫心脏传导阻滞。一度：PR 超过零点二秒，但每次都能下传。二度 I 型：PR 越来越长，直到脱落一个心搏，然后周而复始。二度 II 型：PR 不变，然后突然有一个心搏传不下去。三度：什么都传不下去，P 波和 QRS 各走各的。二度 II 型和宽 QRS 的三度阻滞会突然恶化，书里常用起搏处理。

slides.title: Rhythms that stop the heart
slides.body:
VFchaotic, no real QRSshockable
VTwide, regular, over 100pulseless: shockable
Asystoleflat linenot shockable
  • PEA: an organized rhythm with no pulse; not shockable
  • VF: the most common first rhythm in adult arrest
  • Good compressions slow the slide from coarse to fine VF
  • Worrying PVCs: several shapes, pairs, or landing on the T wave
slides.say: Now the rhythms that matter most. Ventricular fibrillation, or VF, is chaotic quivering with no real QRS, and the most common first rhythm in adult cardiac arrest. Early on the waves are coarse; as energy runs out they become fine, and good compressions slow that slide. Ventricular tachycardia, or VT, is wide, regular and over one hundred; without a pulse it's treated like VF. These two are shockable, exactly what your AED looks for. Asystole is a flat line, and PEA, pulseless electrical activity, is an organized rhythm with no pulse. Neither is shockable. And early ventricular beats, called PVCs, are more worrying in several shapes or pairs, or when one lands on a T wave.
slides.sayZh: 现在讲最要紧的几种心律。心室颤动，即室颤，是杂乱的颤动，没有真正的 QRS，是成人心脏骤停最常见的首发心律。早期波幅大，叫粗颤；能量耗尽后变成细颤，有效按压能延缓这个过程。室性心动过速，即室速，QRS 宽、节律规则、超过一百；没有脉搏时按室颤处理。这两种可以电击，正是 AED 要找的心律。心搏停止是一条直线；PEA，即无脉电活动，是有规整的节律却没有脉搏。这两种都不能电击。还有来自心室的提前心搏，叫室性早搏，形态多样、成对出现，或落在 T 波上时更令人担心。

slides.title: The 12-lead: when and how
slides.body:
• Who: suspected ACS, after ROSC, help with a rhythm
  • Early, before ACS treatment; adds no more than 2 minutes
  • Repeat before you drive off and on arrival: 10–15% more STEMIs
  • V1, V2: 4th space beside the sternum; V4: 5th space, midclavicular
  • V3 between V2 and V4; V5, V6 level with V4
  • Limb electrodes on the limbs; patient supine, warm, still
slides.say: A twelve-lead looks at the heart from twelve angles, so it shows where the muscle is injured. The book uses it for suspected acute coronary syndrome, or ACS, after return of spontaneous circulation, or ROSC, and for confusing rhythms. Do it early, before ACS treatment; it should add no more than two minutes. If there's no STEMI, repeat it before you drive off and on arrival; that catches ten to fifteen percent more. Placement must be exact: V1 and V2 in the fourth space beside the sternum, V4 in the fifth space at the midclavicular line, V3 between them, and V5 and V6 level with V4.
slides.sayZh: 12 导联从十二个角度看心脏，所以能显示哪块心肌受损。书里用于：疑似急性冠脉综合征（ACS）、自主循环恢复（ROSC）之后，以及难认的节律。要早做，在 ACS 治疗之前，增加的时间不超过两分钟。没有 STEMI 的话，出发前和到院时各复做一次，能多发现百分之十到十五。位置必须准确：V1、V2 在胸骨两侧第四肋间，V4 在第五肋间锁骨中线，V3 在两者中间，V5、V6 与 V4 同一水平。

slides.title: Spotting a STEMI
slides.body:
Wall of the left ventricleLeads
InferiorII, III, aVF
SeptalV1, V2
AnteriorV3, V4
LateralV5, V6, I, aVL
  • New ST elevation in 2+ neighbouring leads (≥ 1 mm in most)
  • Reciprocal ST depression in opposite leads supports it
  • A normal ECG does not rule out a heart attack
slides.say: Each group of leads sees one wall of the left ventricle. Leads two, three and aVF see the inferior wall, the bottom. V1 and V2 see the septum, V3 and V4 the front, and V5, V6, one and aVL the side. A STEMI, an ST-elevation heart attack, shows new ST elevation in two or more neighbouring leads, at least one millimetre in most. ST depression in the opposite leads, called reciprocal change, supports it. Early detection can save ten to sixty minutes in opening the artery. But a normal ECG doesn't rule out a heart attack: changes can take hours, and crushing chest pain is treated as one anyway.
slides.sayZh: 每组导联看左心室的一面墙。II、III、aVF 看下壁，也就是底部；V1、V2 看间隔，V3、V4 看前壁，V5、V6、I、aVL 看侧壁。STEMI，即 ST 段抬高型心梗，表现为两个或以上相邻导联出现新的 ST 段抬高，大多数导联至少一毫米。对侧导联的 ST 段压低叫对应性改变，更支持诊断。早发现能让开通血管提前十到六十分钟。但心电图正常不能排除心梗：改变可能要几个小时才出现，压榨性胸痛无论如何都按心梗处理。

slides.title: Inferior STEMI: look right
slides.body:
Inferior STEMI? Think right ventricle

  • About 40% of inferior MIs also involve the right ventricle
  • The right ventricle depends on preload; nitro can crash the BP
  • Clue: low BP with clear lungs
  • Book: 15-lead first: V4R, plus V8 and V9 on the back
  • V4R ST elevation ≥ 1 mm + inferior changes = RVMI: no nitro
slides.say: Here's where the twelve-lead changes your drug decisions. With an inferior STEMI, ST elevation in two, three and aVF, think right ventricle: it's involved in about forty percent. The right ventricle depends on preload, the blood returning to fill it. Nitroglycerin lowers preload, so even a small dose can make the blood pressure crash. A clue is low blood pressure with clear lungs. The book's answer is a fifteen-lead before nitro: V4R on the right chest, and V8 and V9 on the back. ST elevation of one millimetre or more in V4R, plus the inferior changes, means a right ventricular MI, and no nitroglycerin.
slides.sayZh: 这里正是 12 导联改变你用药决定的地方。下壁 STEMI，即 II、III、aVF 的 ST 段抬高，要想到右心室：大约百分之四十会累及。右心室依赖前负荷，也就是回流来充盈它的血。硝酸甘油降低前负荷，所以哪怕小剂量也可能让血压骤降。线索是血压低而肺部清。书里的做法是给硝酸甘油前先做 15 导联：V4R 贴在右胸，V8、V9 贴在背后。V4R 的 ST 段抬高一毫米或以上，加上下壁改变，就是右室心梗，不给硝酸甘油。

slides.q: Crushing chest pain, BP 132/80, regular rate 46 on the monitor. Your ALS partner's 12-lead shows ST elevation in II, III and aVF. Nitroglycerin?
options: Give 0.4 mg SL now: the systolic is over 110
Hold it: a heart rate under 50 is a BC contraindication
Give half a dose to be safe
Give it only after three more 12-leads on scene
slides.say: Here's a decision. Crushing chest pain, a blood pressure of one thirty-two over eighty, and a regular rate of forty-six on the monitor. Your ALS partner's twelve-lead shows ST elevation in two, three and aVF. What about nitroglycerin? A, give zero point four milligrams under the tongue now: the systolic is over one hundred ten. B, hold it: a heart rate under fifty is a BC contraindication. C, give half a dose to be safe. D, give it only after three more twelve-leads on scene. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来做个决定。压榨性胸痛，血压一百三十二比八十，监护仪显示规则心率四十六。你的 ALS 搭档做的 12 导联显示 II、III、aVF 的 ST 段抬高。硝酸甘油怎么办？A 现在舌下给零点四毫克，因为收缩压超过一百一十；B 不给，因为心率低于五十是 BC 的禁忌症；C 给半量比较安全；D 在现场再做三次 12 导联后才给。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. BC lists a heart rate under fifty or over one hundred fifty as a nitroglycerin contraindication, for EMRs and PCPs alike, so a good blood pressure isn't enough. It's also an inferior STEMI, which raises the book's worry about the right ventricle. A ignores the heart rate. C isn't a BC dose. D delays transport; repeat twelve-leads happen before leaving and on arrival, not by holding the patient on scene.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。BC 把心率低于五十或高于一百五十列为硝酸甘油的禁忌症，EMR 和 PCP 都一样，所以光是血压好还不够。而且这是下壁 STEMI，书里会担心右心室。A 忽略了心率；C 不是 BC 的剂量；D 拖延转运，复做 12 导联应该在出发前和到院时，而不是把病人留在现场。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: chest pain and heart rate
slides.body:
BC Cardiac Chest Pain protocol and nitroglycerin monograph. The BC sources don't list monitoring or 12-leads for EMR or PCP.

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Position of comfort; O₂ to SpO₂ ≥ 94%
  • ASA, chewed and swallowed
  • Start transport early
  • History, pain assessment, vital signs
  • Nitro if appropriate: not if SBP < 110, HR < 50 or > 150

PCP adds

  • Vascular access with running IV fluid
  • Consider dimenhydrinate for nausea
slides.say: Let's tie this to the BC cardiac chest pain protocol, where the heart rate really counts. Notice how much is identical for EMRs and PCPs: position of comfort, oxygen to keep the saturation at ninety-four percent or higher, aspirin chewed and swallowed, early transport, the history and vital signs, and nitroglycerin when appropriate. Nitro's BC checks include the heart rate: not under fifty and not over one hundred fifty, plus a systolic of at least one hundred ten. The PCP adds a running IV and dimenhydrinate for nausea. The BC sources don't list rhythms or twelve-leads for either level, but knowing them makes your nitro decision safer.
slides.sayZh: 我们把这些和 BC 心源性胸痛流程连起来，这里心率真正起作用。注意 EMR 和 PCP 有多少是完全一样的：舒适体位；给氧使血氧维持在百分之九十四或以上；阿司匹林嚼服吞下；尽早转运；病史和生命体征；合适时给硝酸甘油。硝酸甘油在 BC 的核查项目包括心率：不低于五十、不高于一百五十，另外收缩压至少一百一十。PCP 多做的是建立静脉通路并保持输液，以及用茶苯海明止恶心。BC 资料没有把心律和 12 导联列给任何级别，但懂这些能让你的硝酸甘油决定更安全。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Treat the patient and the monitor: check before you act
  • A rhythm on the screen with no pulse is PEA: start CPR
  • A normal 12-lead does not clear chest pain
  • Inferior STEMI: think right ventricle before nitro
  • Computer reading: good at intervals, can miss subtle STEMIs
  • The 12-lead never holds you on scene: 2 minutes max
slides.say: Here's what's new to watch out for. First, treat the patient and the monitor together: artifact can mimic VF, and a loose lead can mimic asystole. Second, the reverse is deadly: a normal-looking rhythm with no pulse is PEA, and it needs CPR. Third, a normal twelve-lead doesn't clear chest pain. Fourth, with an inferior STEMI, think right ventricle before nitro. Fifth, the computer reading helps. It's usually right about intervals and rarely wrong when it calls a STEMI, but it can miss subtle ones and misread rhythms with artifact. And the twelve-lead should add no more than about two minutes on scene.
slides.sayZh: 有几件新的事要注意。第一，病人和监护仪一起看：伪差可以像室颤，导联脱落可以像心搏停止。第二，反过来同样致命：看起来正常的节律却没有脉搏，就是 PEA，需要心肺复苏。第三，12 导联正常不代表胸痛没事。第四，下壁 STEMI 要在给硝酸甘油前先想到右心室。第五，电脑判读有帮助：间期通常算得准，报出 STEMI 时很少出错，但可能漏掉不明显的，有伪差时也会认错节律。最后，12 导联在现场增加的时间不应超过大约两分钟。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Rhythm reading, 12-leads: not listed for EMR or PCP in BC protocols
  • Book: atropine for slow rhythms; BC: not on the EMR/PCP exam
  • Nitro: no if SBP < 110, or HR < 50 or > 150
  • Nitro: no if Viagra/Levitra in 24 h, or Cialis in 48 h
  • ASA: 160 mg chewed (book: 160–325 mg)

The written exam can still ask textbook ECG facts.
slides.say: For the BC exam: the BC protocols don't list rhythm interpretation or twelve-leads as EMR or PCP interventions, but the written exam can still ask textbook ECG facts. The book uses atropine for symptomatic slow rhythms; atropine isn't on the BC EMR or PCP licensing exam. For nitroglycerin, BC says no if the systolic is under one hundred ten, the heart rate is under fifty or over one hundred fifty, or the patient took Viagra or Levitra in the last twenty-four hours, or Cialis in the last forty-eight. And BC's aspirin dose is one hundred sixty milligrams, chewed; the book gives one sixty to three twenty-five.
slides.sayZh: BC 考试要记：BC 流程没有把心律判读和 12 导联列为 EMR 或 PCP 的处置项目，但笔试仍可能考书里的心电图知识。书里对有症状的慢心律用阿托品；阿托品 BC 的 EMR 和 PCP 执照考试都不考。硝酸甘油方面，BC 规定：收缩压低于一百一十、心率低于五十或高于一百五十，或者病人二十四小时内用过 Viagra 或 Levitra、四十八小时内用过 Cialis，都不能给。BC 的阿司匹林剂量是一百六十毫克嚼服，书里是一百六十到三百二十五。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Read a strip in 5 steps: waves, PR, QRS, regularity, rate
  2. Shockable: VF and pulseless VT; PEA and asystole are not
  3. Inferior STEMI → think right ventricle; BC nitro needs HR 50–150

Next: cardiac arrest, electrical therapy, heart pumps and heart medicines
slides.say: Three things to remember. One: read any strip in five steps: the waves, the PR interval, the QRS width, the regularity and the rate. Two: VF and pulseless VT are shockable; asystole and PEA are not. Three: inferior ST elevation means think right ventricle, and in BC, nitroglycerin needs a heart rate from fifty to one hundred fifty and a systolic of at least one hundred ten. Next lesson, we put this to work in cardiac arrest: high-quality CPR the BC way, what your ALS partner adds, when to stop, and the pumps and pills you'll find on patients. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 记住三件事。一，任何心电条都用五步读：波形、PR 间期、QRS 宽度、规则性、心率。二，室颤和无脉室速可以电击；心搏停止和 PEA 不行。三，下壁 ST 段抬高就要想到右心室；在 BC，给硝酸甘油要求心率在五十到一百五十之间、收缩压至少一百一十。下节课把这些用到心脏骤停里：按 BC 方式做高质量心肺复苏、ALS 搭档会多做什么、什么时候停止，以及病人身上常见的心脏泵和药。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
